summary.zh: 定义并计算 SaaS 等业务的增长指标
summary.en: Define and track unit economics and growth metrics.

description.zh: 为 SaaS、平台型和 B2B 业务定义关键指标，计算 CAC、LTV 与资金效率，并给出可对标的基准。适合搭建指标看板、判断业务健康度，或向投资人和董事会汇报。
description.en: Defines key metrics for SaaS, marketplace, consumer, and B2B businesses, computes CAC, LTV, and cash efficiency, and adds benchmarks. Fits metric dashboards, health checks, or investor and board reporting.
